dogecoin.text: We watched for Musk because of Doge Coin. I haven’t watched for 30 years. So glad that I don’t. It was the stupidest show I have ever seen. Didn’t even chuckle a little. Stoooooopid!

Well when put into context it doesn’t sound so magnanimous. $50 Mill for him is like me giving the homeless guy at the intersection a $20. Why did he tank Doge Coin on SNL by making a big joke of it? To manipulate the market!
